title: The verifier's contract-event check over the board: definitions and boards, with the row 4.4
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-events-vectors.py, from verifier-ceremony-vectors.py and the records of contract-event.json and contract-event-v2.json to contract-event-v12.json (independent Python implementations)

cases.description: Definition version 1 pinning contract-event version 1: every honest record of contract-event.json, in its order, each passing the event check. 4.4 stays unverifiable (not-implemented): the required entries and the accumulator's replay wait on L2 reads and the archive.
Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 2: every honest record of contract-event-v2.json, the board's events included, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.
Definition version 3 pinning board-entry version 3 and contract-event version 2: a ballot, a share receipt and a group creation, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 3: every honest record of contract-event-v3.json, the board's ballots, relayed ballots and close statements, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 4: every honest record of contract-event-v4.json, a ballot and the board's share-receipt batches, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 5: every honest record of contract-event-v5.json, a ballot, a share-receipt batch and the board's obligation roots of both kinds, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 6: every honest record of contract-event-v6.json, a group creation and the group registry's Tier 1 additions, those the counting rule refuses included, each passing, since version 6 checks an addition's form, not whether it counts (contracts.md, Event tables (version 6)). 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 7: every honest record of contract-event-v7.json, a signed group creation, the group registry's self-paid group creations and additions (an addition naming another group in its record or an index beyond the count included: those are 2.4's replay, never the event check's) and a signed addition, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 8: every honest record of contract-event-v8.json, a ballot, an obligation root and the board's availability attestations and complaints (of the author panel, of seat 255, naming a definition no election has and signed by another seat's key included: those are the availability check's, never the event check's), each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 9: every honest record of contract-event-v9.json, the election registry's author panel registrations, the board's version-1 and version-4 ballots, relayed ballots and every delivery record, batch and root of versions 1 and 2 (those whose elements frame but aren't points included: they are the verifier's later checks, never the event check's), each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 10: every honest record of contract-event-v10.json, the board's version-1 and version-4 ballots and its rolling ballots of version 5 with their supplied roots (a root that isn't its step's and a ballot no rolling poll would admit included: those are 5.1's and admission's, never the event check's), each passing, though the definition is a fixed poll's. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 11: every honest record of contract-event-v11.json, a rolling ballot, a relayed version-1 ballot and the board's relayed rolling ballots with their call fields and supplied roots (a call the relay never recorded and a root that isn't its step's included: those are 4.5's and 5.1's, never the event check's), each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Contract-event version 10, which doesn't name the relayed rolling ballot: an honest version-1 ballot submission, then contract-event-v11.json's `relayed-rolling-call` log in a version-10 record, as a board with the relayed rolling call emits into the sequence every election shares: unknown-event at entry 1, so a profile pinning version 10 fails 4.4 at the first rolling ballot forced through L1 (contracts.md, Event tables (version 11); T-53).

Definition version 4 pinning board-entry version 4 and contract-event version 12: every honest record of contract-event-v12.json, the trustee registry's panels pinned with each kind (one whose logged quorum is `k` included: whether it is the release's is 3.1's, and whether the kind is the release's 2.5's, never the event check's) and a ceremony registration, each passing. 4.4 is not-implemented.

Contract-event version 11, which doesn't name the kind-carrying `PanelPinned`: contract-event-v11.json's honest relayed version-1 ballot, then contract-event-v12.json's `panel-pinned-4-of-7` log in a version-11 record, as a trustee registry that logs the kind emits at deployment into the sequence every election shares: unknown-event at entry 1, so a profile pinning version 11 fails 4.4 at that registry's first event (contracts.md, Event tables (version 12); T-53).
No contract-event record on the copy: 4.4 is not-implemented, never a pass, since which events must be boarded isn't known yet.

Contract-event version 2: an honest creation, a ballot whose hash topic disagrees with its record (event-data), then a version-1 encoding, which doesn't decode under the version-2 pin (decode, profile-mismatch). The first failure in copy order decides 4.4: event-data at entry 1.
